name_vi: Khay phục vụ hình quả thận
description_en: One rattan and bamboo household product. Front: A kidney-shaped shallow serving tray with a continuous rounded rim and no handles. Side: Its curved edge rises evenly above a flat bamboo base. Rear: The concave rear edge exposes reinforced rim lashings and underside bamboo ribs. Smooth bound joints, visibly interlaced natural fibers, empty clean inserts where specified. No writing, numbers, logos, marks, labels or other objects.
prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Input image 1 is the FRONT of this exact kidney-shaped rattan tray. Create ONE REAR catalog photograph after moving camera exactly 180 degrees around it, with no object redesign. The near-facing rim must now be the broad smooth CONVEX outer edge, uninterrupted and bulging toward the viewer. Its distinctive INWARD center concavity must move to the FAR rim, away from viewer, partially hidden behind the center interior. Do not repeat the concave front edge near the viewer; that would be the wrong view. Preserve exact walnut-brown dye, hexagonal cane lattice, dimensions, rim thickness, binding locations and plain white studio background. Whole tray resting flat, no tilt, no props, no text or logos. Camera centered straight on the back, slightly enough above to show the far concavity.

visual_review.method: manual comparison of canonical front and three-view review sheet
